name: Mohawk Industries
outlook:
What Mohawk Industries says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted EPSFor the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects adjusted EPS in the range of $1.35 to $1.45.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted net salesLooking ahead to the fourth quarter, which has four fewer shipping days versus the prior year and three fewer shipping days versus the third quarter of the current year, the Company assumes flooring market conditions will be softer relative to the third quarter and expects low single-digit growth in adjusted net sales versus the prior year.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresThe Company now anticipates full-year capital expenditures of approximately $445 million versus its previous expectation of $460 million, and expects free cash flow during the fourth quarter of 2026 to follow typical seasonality.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
